## Summary

The retry helper exceeds the five-attempt limit in the loaded project policy and should be corrected before merge.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/net.py:13 — correctness — When the upstream consistently raises OSError, the default call makes ten attempts, exceeding the loaded project policy’s five-attempt maximum. Please cap both the default and accepted attempts at five and update the tests accordingly. — A failing upstream receives twice the permitted requests, increasing load and delaying failure propagation.

(none)

## Strengths
- Tests cover recovery after transient failures, exhaustion, invalid attempt bounds, and avoiding sleep after a single failed attempt.
- Exhaustion re-raises the upstream exception, preserving its diagnostic information.
